prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1181; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection in Pearland when a vehicle coming from my right struck the side of my car. The light had been green for me, and I remember clearly that I had already started moving through when the impact came. My car spun partway around before stopping at the curb. I was shaken, and I felt sharp pain in my left wrist almost immediately, so I did not try to move my hand. I have described what happened the same way to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff who treated me. I am the named driver on this policy, and I was operating the vehicle with the permission and knowledge of the policyholder at the time. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I am willing to provide any further details or photographs that would help.
